messages:
ana: quick roundup for the week — token-cost attribution, latency blip last night, and an event-schema change that needs owner signoff. TL;DR: I have a small checklist below. :wave:

mike: looking — I saw a 95->99.9th increase around 02:14 UTC on dedicated-us-east. batching config change rolled at 01:55, might be related. link to perf graph: https://dash.re/redwood/alerts/2891 :eyes:

tom: I pulled the node GC/heap logs and there wasn't a large GC pause. traces show many requests waiting on KV cache misses (~12% miss rate at the time). attaching sampling snippet:
```
# kv miss tail samples
2026-03-16T02:14:10Z request_id=abc123 wait_kv_ms=48
2026-03-16T02:14:11Z request_id=def456 wait_kv_ms=52
```

leslie: quick schema note — the embeddings_event currently uses field "model" but we want to rename to "model_name" to avoid confusion with runtime model_id. Proposal: backfill older events with a mapper and leave both fields readable for 30 days. sample event: 
```json
{
  "event_type": "embedding",
  "model_name": "openllama-13b-q4",
  "embedding_len": 1536,
  "route": "/v1/embeddings"
}
```

mike: +1 for backfill. We should also surface the mapping in token-cost attribution so costs map to model_name consistently. who owns the mapper and rollout? @jordan? :raised_hands:

jordan: I can own the mapper, deployment, and smoke tests. plan: open PR for mapper + e2e smoke tomorrow AM, then canary deploy to instr-pipeline on Wednesday. ETA EOD tomorrow for PR.

dena: for token-cost attribution we need a route->model_name mapping snapshot for the last 14 days to compute unit costs. ana — can you export the route list and attach? also need to confirm whether any route uses multiple model variants (e.g., small/large fallback).

ana: tagging — I'll export the route mapping now and drop a CSV into the shared drive under /projects/instrumentation/exports/routes_14d.csv. Checklist I'm following: 
- exporter done (ana)
- mapper PR opened (jordan)
- canary mapping + smoke tests (jordan)
- telemetry flag to enable backfill (eng-infra)
- update cost aggregation job to prefer model_name (analytics)

mike: small ops note — while canary is running, please set batching config to legacy (pre-01:55) on 10% of traffic to confirm regression goes away. I can flip during business hours.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for instr-mapper v2 -> cluster: instr-prod-canary (id: deploy-789)

tom: I'll watch KV cache miss rate during canary. if miss rate drops the tail should improve.

jordan: PR link: https://git.re/redwood/instr/merge_requests/532 (will add smoke tests + README). cc @leslie for schema notes.

dena: once PR is merged I will run the cost-recompute job against a 3-day window to sanity-check attribution. want to avoid large retroactive billing changes — we'll stage in analytics and run diff reports.

ana: thanks everyone. action items recap: 
- jordan: open PR + own canary + smoke tests (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- ana: export route -> model mapping (done, uploaded)
- mike: coordinate batching legacy fallback for 10% during canary
- tom: monitor KV miss and tail latency during canary
- dena: prepare cost-recompute script and diff report
- leslie: confirm backfill spec and output schema docs

mike: thanks. I'll queue a 15-min quick-check tomorrow at 10:30 PT if that helps to watch canary together.

leslie: added schema PR checklist in the repo under docs/schema-backfill.md

ana: noted. will follow up in ticket #4567 and drop final rollout timeline there. :thumbsup:

jordan: will ping here once PR is merged.

mike: closing loop — great coordination, feels unblockable for now. :rocket:
